name: Hard Gaussian Splatting
aliases: Rendering Error guided Hard Gaussian Splatting
definition: A method that addresses artifacts in 3DGS by growing 'hard Gaussians' identified via multi-view significant positional gradients and rendering errors, rather than relying on averaged gradients.
summary: Hard Gaussian Splatting is a densification strategy that identifies and grows defective primitives causing artifacts by using multi-view positional gradients and rendering error analysis to recover missing scene details.
